I will answer your plane questions later. Suffice to say your call the other day was debilitating and I am
not as emotionally strong as I should be. The downstream effects is that I am unable to successfully
engage with my kids who themselves have taken a leg down to be virtually without interest in the social
world. There does not seem to be a break to this spiral downward. Beyond depressed and outcome bleak
and also I feel that you are looking for an advantage in a chess game and I am merely a pawn sacrifice.
Brad said you boasted to LDB after Thursday's call. That really hurt me. And I am crying as I type this.
I am not best suited for this any more and will be taking a job at RSM. I have not told Brad yet but will do
so later this am. I am a broken man and need to find a way to help my kids. I now face two years tuition, a
crazy ex, kids who barely speak and low pay Inf public accounting to support them. And trying to negotiate
a contract with Elysium that might provide some security seems like I ultimately will be crushed anyway
and at my age jobs are scarce. I appreciate the help you extended to my son.
